const OCTAL_BOUND = 8
typedef float ratio_t
typedef double measure_t
typedef quadruple wide_t
struct full_record_t
  opaque fixed[OCTAL_BOUND]
  ratio_t *next
union payload_t
  switch int kind
    case 1
      int single
    case 2
    case 3
      string text<>
    default
      void nothing
typedef enum { VALUE_ONE = 1, VALUE_TWO = 2 } inline_enum_t
